definition:
Graph with a self-loop and a cycle:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[🔁 retry 再試行] --> A
    A --> B{decide 判断}
    B --> C[commit]
    C --> A
    B --> B
    A[🔁 retry 再試行] --> D[مخرج]
    D --> C
```

The self-edges on `A` and `B` and the `A -> B -> C -> A` cycle are intentional.
